verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes an extensive Developer API (174 documented OpenAPI paths spanning transactions, bills, cards, reimbursements, banking, accounting, applications, incorporation) plus a CLI and MCP servers that mirror most UI actions like approvals, payments, and card issuance. However, Ramp's own docs admit a concrete gap ('Bill approvals aren't yet available via MCP — use the Ramp UI or the Blank Canvas Approvals API for now'), and there is no explicit vendor claim of full 1:1 UI/API parity across all features (e.g., hotel rebooking automation, investment account management specifics). Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee/statement, independent verification of full feature coverage, and closure of the documented MCP bill-approval gap.
